_comment: Performance grid + cluster membership owned by skills/route. Data lives here (not in portable SKILL.md instructions, per the model-rightsizing policy). Content derives from arena cycles only (skills/arena); cells marked provisional are not routing-grade until their cycle closes. Cost conventions: hosted = API $ per leg (pi cost.total); local = electricity at 0.23 EUR/kWh x 600 W (registered 2026-10-06).

grid.role: consistency buyer — the only arm without a crater; hard/monster work
best fully-covered arm of the tournament (26.5 median, 10/10); 30/30 unanimous on the killer ticket; beats hosted Sol 6.1 @medium paired 7-2
quality parity with Luna paired (median 0.0); DNFs the killer ticket — speed tier for non-judgment work
solid mid hosted; strictly dominates its own @medium point (quality tie, faster 9/10, cheaper 10/10)
daily local seat + vision niche; DNF on the killer ticket
fastest hosted; quality tie with Sol @low (paired 4-6) at lower latency and cost
DEFAULT WORKHORSE: parity with the old locals paired, 10x speed, no crater observed

VOID-EMPTY on 0452/0673/1372, DNF on 0211 — heavy-work abandoner
FALSE-COMPLETION family — never route real work here

MILIEU SOLIDE.when: real implementation work; hosted is fine
